error.file_input_invalid: The selected image is invalid. Choose a nonempty PNG or JPEG image.
error.file_input_too_large: The image exceeds the 1 MiB limit. Choose a smaller image.
error.file_input_limit: The local image selection limit is reached. Remove an image before retrying.
error.file_input_busy: An image import is in progress. Wait and retry.
error.file_input_not_found: The image selection is no longer available. Select the image again.
error.file_input_unavailable: Local image selection is unavailable. Retry in the desktop application.
error.desktop_not_started: Desktop services are starting. Retry shortly; log operation: startup.
error.desktop_startup_failed: Desktop initialization failed. Check the startup log entry.
error.workspace_unavailable: Unable to read the run workspace. Retry, then check the load_workspace log entry if it still fails.
error.catalog_unavailable: Unable to read the model, channel and case catalog. Retry; log operation: load_catalog.
error.reports_unavailable: Unable to read test reports. Retry; log operation: load_reports.
error.comparison_unavailable: Unable to read channel comparisons. Retry; log operation: load_comparisons.
error.operation_failed: The desktop operation failed; check local logs
error.catalog_invalid: The catalog content is invalid; check the form fields
error.catalog_revision_conflict: The object version changed or is still referenced. Refresh, remove references, and try again.
error.catalog_not_found: The object was deleted or does not exist. Refresh the catalog.
error.catalog_saved_refresh_failed: Saved, but the catalog could not refresh. Refresh or reopen the app.
error.plan_protocol_mismatch: The cases, model and channel use different protocols. Select a model and channel compatible with the cases, or adjust the cases or suite.
error.run_invalid: Invalid test inputs. Check task parameters, model, and connection details.
error.run_not_runnable: The selected task or target cannot run. Check model applicability, Case status, and channel credentials.
error.run_not_active: The run is no longer active, so it cannot be cancelled or stopped.
error.quick_task_credential_unavailable: The remembered key is unavailable. Enter a key again or restore access to the system credential store.
error.comparison_invalid: The channel comparison request is invalid. Select a plan and at least two channels.
error.comparison_not_ready: The selected channels cannot be compared fairly with the same model revision. Check the model mappings and retry.
error.comparison_target_unmapped: The selected model is not bound to one of the channels. Add the channel-model mapping first.
error.comparison_channel_not_ready: One of the selected channels is disabled or has no credential, so it cannot join the comparison.
error.remote_nodes_unavailable: Remote node management is unavailable. Retry in the desktop application.
error.remote_node_invalid: Check the node connection and authentication settings.
error.remote_node_revision_conflict: The node configuration changed. Refresh before retrying.
error.remote_node_not_found: The remote node no longer exists. Refresh the list.
error.remote_node_re_pair_required: The connection identity is bound. Create a new node for a different server or installation.
error.remote_node_still_referenced: The node is selected as default, has an unresolved installation, or is referenced by a task.
error.remote_node_usage_unavailable: Task and report synchronization cannot be confirmed. The node cannot be removed.
error.remote_node_credential_unavailable: Re-enter node credentials or check the system credential store.
error.remote_node_busy: A node operation is in progress. Refresh shortly.
error.remote_node_commit_unconfirmed: The save is not confirmed. Refresh the node list before continuing.
error.job_invalid: Invalid job input. Check the execution location and parameters.
error.job_not_found: No associated job was found in this query range. Open it from Job history; historical unmanaged runs cannot receive Job commands.
error.job_conflict: The job revision changed and the command was refused. Refresh the job before a new action.
error.job_unavailable: The selected execution location is unavailable. Check the node or restart the app before launching.
error.job_confirmation_pending: The executor has not confirmed this job. Check the original task before creating another.
error.job_commit_unconfirmed: Command persistence is unconfirmed. Refresh the control history before sending another command.
error.job_query_unavailable: Durable job queries are unavailable. Refresh or inspect local logs.
error.job_commands_unavailable: Job commands are unavailable. Try again in the desktop application.
error.remote_node_upgrade_required: This node configuration format requires an upgrade.
error.remote_node_identity_conflict: The runner identity changed. Read the current node state before continuing.

errorCode.network_error: Unable to connect to the endpoint
errorCode.semantic_empty: Endpoint returned no valid model content
errorCode.response_too_large: Endpoint response exceeded the safety limit
errorCode.run_state_transition_failed: The run could not update its state
errorCode.result_persistence_failed: The run could not save results
